title: Empty logs show '0 of 0 matching calls' above 'No AI calls yet'
where: /admin/sessions/[code]/logs, session with no AI calls, no filter on
what_happens: Two lines say the same thing, and the first one says 'matching' though no filter is on (the Filter button is correctly hidden).
who_hurts: Admins briefly wonder whether a filter is hiding rows.
suggested_fix: Hide the count line when there are no rows and no filter; keep the empty card. logs/page.tsx:441-444.
rule: Dane's UI rule: 'Be careful about redundant titles, headings ... avoid repeating the same thing twice on one screen.'
